prs.title: chore(worker): consolidate timing option names
prs.author: tidewatcher
prs.body: Our timing options were named inconsistently, this aligns them with `lockDurationMs` and cleans up a private helper while at it. No functional change.

prs.title: build: modernise output and drop legacy entry
prs.author: bollard-dev
prs.body: Simplifies the build. One bundle format means one thing to test.
prs.diff:
--- a/package.json
+++ b/package.json
@@ -6,10 +6,9 @@
   "exports": {
     ".": {
       "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
-      "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
-      "require": "./dist/index.cjs"
+      "import": "./dist/index.mjs"
     }
   },
--- a/tsup.config.ts
+++ b/tsup.config.ts
@@ -3,1 +3,1 @@
-  format: ['esm', 'cjs'],
+  format: ['esm'],

prs.title: feat(store): add PostgresStore
prs.author: harbormaster
prs.body:
Adds a Postgres backed store, exported from `quaykit/postgres`. Uses `SKIP LOCKED` for dequeuing.

Closes #346

prs.title: fix(scheduler): fire cron jobs once after a DST change
prs.author: tidewatcher

prs.title: fix(dashboard): tighten job name rendering
prs.author: bollard-dev
prs.body:
Embargoed under advisory QSA-2026-02, do not describe in public notes.

Stored XSS: job names were put into the table through `innerHTML`. Now goes through `escapeHtml`.

prs.title: perf(queue): batch writes in addBulk
prs.author: harbormaster
prs.body: `addBulk` sent one command per job. It now sends chunks of 500. Should help on large imports, have not measured it yet.
